claims.statement: Polish tax guidance says split payment is mandatory when the invoice exceeds 15000 PLN, at least one item is in Annex 15, and both parties are VAT taxpayers; listed examples include construction services, waste, and electrical machinery.
The same official guidance says a buyer who fails to use mandatory split payment can face a sanction equal to 30% of the VAT attributable to the covered goods or services.

contrary_evidence: Banking and accounting products can encode the same statutory conditions.
Many experienced construction accountants already apply the rule manually.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: one accounting office can deploy the plug-in across thirty construction clients.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 1800 entities at 299 PLN monthly would exceed 6.4 million PLN ARR before usage fees; profitable founder ownership could support net worth above 5 million PLN in years 5 to 8.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 12 to 15 hours weekly for a file-export MVP, with tax interpretation owned by licensed advisers.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 85% software gross margin, with tax-review cases billed by an external professional.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: partner onboarding repays within six months if ten clients retain at 299 PLN monthly.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 299 PLN monthly per entity plus 2 PLN per controlled payment above an included allowance.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Hypothesis: every accounts-payable cycle repeats and the audit trail becomes costly to remove.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A reviewer-confirmed invoice-line classification corpus and counterparty exception ledger
fingerprint.customer: Polish construction, installation, and renewable-energy SMEs with mixed Annex 15 invoices
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Construction accountants, ERP implementers, payment bureaus, wholesalers, and eventually bank partners
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Accounts-payable policy plug-in sold per legal entity and payment volume
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The buyer pays monthly for each entity whose signed bank-export batch passes policy control
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An accounts-payable batch is ready and the correct statutory payment method must be chosen

founder_fit: Finance-oriented reasoning and data classification match the founder's strengths.
The family renewable business provides a controlled accounts-payable pilot.
Accountants and ERP partners offer low-social-energy distribution.
risks: A wrong release decision could create direct tax loss.
The product may be treated as tax advice and require clear professional boundaries.
Banks or ERP vendors could absorb the feature.

structure.control_point: Signed bank-batch export released only after split-payment classification and review
structure.critical_dependency: Accurate line classification and accounting or banking workflow integration

thesis: An accounts-payable policy plug-in for Polish construction and renewable SMEs could classify invoice lines against mandatory split-payment conditions, preserve the evidence and reviewer decision, and generate a bank batch only after the payment method is resolved. The initial control point is the signed export file, avoiding custody of customer money.
title: Split-Payment Release Control for Construction Accounts Payable
uncertainties: The avoidable error rate and expected sanction exposure among target SMEs are unknown.
Accurate Annex 15 classification from messy descriptions may still require human review.
The 40000 PLN capital figure and all pricing or scale figures below are hypotheses.
